_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Real Property Installed Equipment (RPIE) Manuals
summary: Specifies the format and content preparation instructions for Real Property Installed Equipment (RPIE) manuals required to operate and maintain indirect systems and equipment.
description_purpose: This Data Item Description (DID) is for preparation of RPIE manuals required to operate and maintain indirect systems and equipment.  Data for inclusion in these manuals are also utilized for design integration and during installation and checkout.
application_interrelationship:
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the RPIE system manuals resulting from the work task described by 3.1 of MIL-M-38312B and 3.1 of MIL-M-38313C.

This DID is for application to those systems which utilize extensive RPIE and on which the RPIE, due to extensive interface, must be operated and maintained as an integral part of the total system, often by system maintenance personnel, as well as base civil engineers or contractor personnel.

The Technical Manual Publications Plan (DI-TMSS-80063) shall include this data requirement when both technical manuals and RPIE manuals are contractually incorporated.  NOTE: RPIE manuals are not technical manuals as defined in AFR 8-2.

This DID supersedes DI-M-3406.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates, and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.

children.title: The system manuals shall be in reproducible copy
The equipment manuals shall be complete manuals
children.content: assembled and arranged in accordance with MIL-M-38312.  Additional pages prepared by the contractor (cover pages, introductory pages, supplemental data, etc.) shall be collated into manuals.

children.title: Manual numbers are furnished from the contract
A notice shall be completed for each
children.content: classified manual to be classified.  In addition, the appropriate portion of the applicable security guide used as an authority shall be referenced.  A notice shall be furnished whenever a classified manual is prepared or the classification of the manual changes.

children.title: Data to be furnished as Government-Furnished Equipment (GFE)
children.content: for incorporation into the manuals shall be acquired direct from the manufacturers as stated in contract direction.

children.title: Requirements contained herein shall not generate
children.content: the duplication of data already developed by the contractor.

children.title: Equipment and systems manuals listed in Table
children.content: I shall be completed in support of the RPIE which is required to support systems that interface with or incorporate RPIE end items.  If manuals are not listed as GFE or if additional manuals are proposed in support of this requirement, the contractor shall propose manuals to the procuring activity for approval.

preparation_instructions.title: Changes and Revisions
preparation_instructions.content: Manuals shall include necessary changes and revisions to keep them up-to-date as specified by the DD Form 1423.  Changes and revisions shall provide instructions and data to reflect design, production, or modification changes.  Changes shall be in the same style and format as the basic manuals.

preparation_instructions.title: Manual Changes Resulting From Engineering Changes

children.title: Changes to system manuals resulting from engineering
children.content: changes shall be completed in accordance with a procedure approved by the program or project manager.  The manuals shall reflect "before and after" modification instructions information.  The "before" modification instructions shall remain in the applicable manual until changes have been made to all affected hardware.

children.title: Changes to equipment manuals resulting from engineering drawings
children.content: shall be completed from vendor data furnished by the Government and supplemented, as necessary, by the contractor.  These changes shall be approved and incorporated as directed by the procuring activity.
